Phone Screening Software Pricing: $4 per Completed Screen · PhoneScreen.AI

name: PhoneScreen.AI
summary: AI interviewer that phone-screens every hourly applicant in 34 languages, plus resume screening and reference-check agents.
description: An AI interviewer calls, or takes calls from, every hourly applicant 24/7, asks your questions in their language and returns a scored scorecard with transcript and recording; separate agents screen resumes and check references. It runs from ChatGPT or Claude and connects via ATS integrations, Zapier, API and webhooks, with preset questions for warehouses, home care, restaurants, retail, hotels, trucking and staffing. First 10 screens free, then $4 per completed screen.
contains: AI phone screens in 34 languages with per-answer scoring against your rubric
resume screener (free, no account needed) and reference-check agent (beta)
scorecard, transcript and recording for every completed screen
presets for 30 roles across 11 industries; missed calls never charged
integrations: ATS, Zapier, API, webhooks, MCP; runs from ChatGPT or Claude
first 10 screens free, then $4 per completed screen, no monthly fee
2,486 completed screens analyzed for 83 hiring teams; median screen 4.4 min
